verified: Not a Tesla App reported on November 25 that Tesla raised the Cyberbeast to $114,990 and ended Cybertruck leasing, with estimated deliveries stretching to June 2027; Teslahubs, citing the same change, puts the increase at $5,000 from $109,990 and gives a delivery window of March–June 2027, and KBB reported on November 17 that the Cyberbeast was the only Cybertruck trim still open for orders in the U.S.
unconfirmed: No Tesla statement is quoted, so the company's own confirmation of the price, the scope of the lease removal (all trims and markets, or U.S. only) and the delivery dates rests on secondary reporting. The sources also disagree on the price figure: KBB listed $112,235 on November 17, before the reported $5,000 increase, while Teslahubs cites $109,990 as the prior price; the reports do not explain whether the gap reflects fees, destination charges or a different configuration.

verified: 多家专注特斯拉的媒体报道，Cyberbeast 目前标价为 114,990 美元，较此前的 109,990 美元上涨 5,000 美元（teslahubs 与 Not a Tesla App 报道）；特斯拉已停止新订单的租赁选项，目前仅保留现金与贷款两种方式；基础版与 Premium 版 Cybertruck 已停止接单，Cyberbeast 成为美国唯一可订车型（KBB 11 月 17 日报道）。
unconfirmed: 上述价格与停租信息均出自媒体转述，而非特斯拉官网或官方声明，交付时间只有“2027 年 3 月至 6 月”的订单页面估算，并非承诺日期；此外，KBB 在 11 月 17 日报道的 Cyberbeast 价格为 112,235 美元，与本次报道的 114,990 美元不一致，两者之间是否又涨过一次价、还是统计口径（如是否含运费等费用）不同，现有报道均未说明。

titles.en: Tesla raises Cyberbeast price to $114,990 and ends Cybertruck leasing
titles.zh: 特斯拉 Cyberbeast 涨价至 11.499 万美元，Cybertruck 停止租赁
